name: Josibiah
title: Returning Levite under Ezra
summary: Josibiah was a leader among those who returned to Jerusalem from exile in Babylon. He is mentioned in the book of Ezra as one of those sent to Casiphia to bring Levites and temple servants for the journey back to Jerusalem. His role was important in ensuring that worship in the rebuilt temple could be carried out with adequate staffing.

keyEvents.title: Ezra's Preparation for the Return Journey
keyEvents.description: Ezra gathered the people by the river that flows to Ahava to prepare for the journey back to Jerusalem from Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Mission to Casiphia
keyEvents.description: Josibiah is mentioned as a leading man at the place Casiphia, where Ezra sent messengers to get Levites and temple servants to join the caravan returning to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Levites Join the Journey
keyEvents.description: Thanks to the appeal to Josibiah and others at Casiphia, Levites and temple servants came who joined Ezra's caravan.

keyEvents.title: Fasting and Prayer Before Departure
keyEvents.description: Ezra proclaimed a fast at the Ahava River to seek God's protection for the dangerous journey to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Arrival in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The caravan arrived safely in Jerusalem under God's protection, and those who had come from Casiphia through Iddo's assistance were able to serve in the temple.
